scope: Source visual fidelity only; not topology, manufacturing or structural certification

findings.detail: Roof, stout columns, pierced parapets and platform form complete coherent pavilion; approach bridges, water and garden excluded as disclosed.

Source photos support at least seven true columns with overlap. Eight-column/eight-roof-face rhythm is plausible cross-view reconstruction, with unseen column/rear repeated by symmetry. Photo4 x267 palm trunk explicitly excluded. README does not claim all eight independently visible.

Elevation roof-span/overall-height and clear-column-height ratios remain broadly consistent with source3 image ratios. Model is not measured scale. Perspective views do not support precise dimensions.
Open pavilion sides remain genuinely open; paired clipped-corner parapet holes and opposed entry bays retained. Exact unseen parapet positions remain inferred.

Swept rising roof, radial hips, center finial and muted yellow-green palette retained. Individual tiles, scalloped decorative fascia, meander carving and shaped capitals are substantially simplified; renderer shows ribbed roof rather than detailed tile reproduction. README explicitly discloses coarse ornamental approximation.
Rear symmetrical repetition and regular octagonal plan are reconstruction choices, not observed complete roof survey. Preview labels state inferred rear/top.

limitations: Source capture/publication dates unknown; no 2026 current-state verification.
No source photo permits exact roof underside/interior framing or underwater footing reconstruction.
Central short platform support is display approximation; actual bridge support pier and waterline are not reproduced completely.
Existing thin-feature and support warnings remain; visual acceptance does not override QA flags or imply support-free printing.
release_condition: Preserve current prominent inferred-eightfold and source-limit disclosures; bind this review only to listed hashes.
